ModMetaData.name: Colony Task Auditor
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
Monitors construction, mining, deconstruction, production bills, sowing/harvesting, unfinished products and milking/shearing, and diagnoses why tasks stall (workers, skills, materials, forbidden, reservations, reachability) with an explicit confidence level. Diagnosis only: it never forces jobs, deletes orders or changes settings. Requires Harmony.
作業指示の停滞を監視し、原因を確信度付きで診断します。作業の強制・指示の削除・設定の変更は行いません。Harmonyが必要です。
